skills.description: Fast, source-backed answer to a factual question — a technology, a term/noun, a date/version/value, or a "is it true that…" claim. Speed/efficiency is the defining goal. Use when the user wants a quick verified answer: "fact-check this", "quickly find out / look up X", "what is <tech/term>", "is it true that Y", "$fact-check".
